A '''monofilament screen guard''' was a device used for perimeter security. It was made up of an 80-[[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter]]-long strip with hundreds of [[monofilament wire]]s that rose to a height of two [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. It was very hard to detect and if a person ran into it, it could inflict significant cuts and damage.
